now.title: Now
now.text: This year I'm going below the agents: GPU programming in CUDA, parallel computing with MPI, and deep learning for vision. Last year I ranked first of seventeen in System Design and validated a Rust traceroute engine at the LIP6 lab.
now.caption: A tiny CUDA kernel: 504 threads in 7 blocks, each lighting one dot.

about.title: I like knowing what happens under the button.
about.text: I started freelancing in the second year of my degree and shipped 165 projects for clients. Then came an operations platform for a restaurant group in Dubai, a document editor for researchers in Finland, and two years leading engineering at Mavera, all remotely, before I moved to Paris for my master's.

contact.title: Let's build something together.
